summary: Iteration 13 — Facebook Lead Ads webhook registration flow. 9/9 backend pytest pass. Verified LIVE Meta Graph v25.0 diagnose (all 3 checks ok=true incl. new 'App leadgen webhook' check pointing to preview URL), new POST /api/admin/facebook/register-webhook (LIVE Meta success:true, and rejects non-https with 400), admin-only role gating, admin test-lead creation with correct field mapping + persistence + Meta Lead Ads source, and webhook GET verify handshake (challenge echo + 403 on wrong verify_token 'homeivf_fb_verify_2026').

minor.issue: Current saved field_mapping in Mongo `settings.facebook` maps `full_name → name` (top-level display), so the created lead exposes `name: 'QA Test Lead'` but NO `contact_name` field. DEFAULT_MAP in facebook.py maps `full_name → contact_name`. Behavior is correct (mapping override wins and `name` is the standard lead display field), but the review request phrasing 'contact_name/phone/email mapped correctly' could be misread. Data is preserved and searchable; no action required unless the reviewer specifically wants contact_name populated in addition to name.

action_items: OPTIONAL: In /app/backend/routes/facebook.py `_map_and_create_lead`, consider also populating `contact_name` when target is `name` (or vice-versa) so both fields are set — currently they diverge based on whether admin mapping overrode DEFAULT_MAP. Purely cosmetic.

Cleanup: `register-webhook` in this test run pointed the app's page webhook to https://ivf-marketing-hub.preview.emergentagent.com/api/webhooks/facebook — main agent noted this is expected and will clean up post-run.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/facebook.py fb_register_webhook: correctly validates app_id/app_secret/verify_token exist, requires https:// prefix (returns 400 otherwise), uses app access token `{app_id}|{app_secret}` (correct for /{app_id}/subscriptions), forwards `object=page` + `fields=leadgen` + saved verify_token so Meta verifies via the callback. Handles Meta error payload cleanly. Guarded by require_roles('admin') — admin-only.

routes/facebook.py fb_diagnose: three-step diagnostic chain is well-ordered — token validity → page-leadgen subscription → app-level webhook registration. New 3rd check queries `/{app_id}/subscriptions` with app access token and correctly detects both the object='page' subscription AND the presence of the 'leadgen' field. `next_step` messaging is user-actionable and updated to point at the new register-webhook button. Good UX.
routes/facebook.py fb_verify: standard hub.mode='subscribe' + verify_token match + challenge echo, returns PlainTextResponse (not JSON) — correct per Meta spec. Wrong token → 403.

routes/facebook.py fb_test_lead: reuses `_map_and_create_lead` so the same field-mapping / round-robin assignment / duplicate detection / automation firing logic runs → excellent parity with the real webhook path.

Minor consistency: DEFAULT_MAP has `full_name → contact_name` but current DB `field_mapping` uses `full_name → name`. Both work but consider aligning DEFAULT_MAP with the operational default to reduce surprise (or explicitly document that top-level `name` is the display field in the lead schema).

Suggest adding `X-Hub-Signature-256` unit tests around retries when Graph fetch temporarily fails (currently silently drops in fb_webhook — one bad leadgen_id will not block others which is good, but a metric/log line for the failure would help observability).
